lastRequest:
Role: You are a Senior Creative Frontend Engineer building an Awwwards-quality single-page scrollytelling showcase.

Objective: Build a production-ready, single-page showcase for Cinematic Transformer Sequence. Core mechanic: a scroll-driven image-sequence (frame images) used as the background, with a HUD-style overlay whose content transitions strictly based on scroll progress. The sequence is the hero: a mechanical truck transforming into a humanoid robot across 204 frames. The background environment evolves with the transformation. The experience

must feel cinematic, aggressive, minimal, and dark.

tasks.title: Project Setup and Architecture
tasks.description: Initialize React, Vite, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Setup clean project structure, constants, state management models, and audio/animation utility wrappers.

tasks.title: Core Components and UI Layout
tasks.description: Develop modular UI components for mecha specification panels, HUD overlays, control decks, and responsive typography layouts.

tasks.title: Scrollytelling and Transformation Engine
tasks.description: Implement high-performance scroll-driven animation logic, part-by-part mecha assembly/disassembly sequencing, and camera/canvas transformations.

tasks.title: Audio FX and Interactive Polish
tasks.description: Integrate synthesized or asset-based mechanical sound effects synced to scroll milestones, particle effects, and responsive touch/mouse controls.

tasks.title: Validation and Performance Optimization
tasks.description: Perform rigorous cross-browser testing, bundle size optimization, frame-rate profiling during scroll transformations, and accessibility checks.
